title: Blood Type Supply Varies By Distribution, Rh Status, And Donor Background
hook: Blood supply depends on rarity and on who shows up to donate.
closing: Knowing your blood type helps reveal where donor supply is strongest or thinnest.
question: Do you know your blood type?

segments.say: AB-negative represents just 1% of the population. It sits at the rarest edge of blood type distribution.
Rh-negative blood represents 15% of the population. Negative blood types draw from a much smaller donor pool.
O-positive reaches 53% among Latin American donors. Donor background helps shape the available blood supply.
